name: Sweet Angel
original_name: スウィートエンジェル
source:
The player takes the role of Seisa, a bald-headed photographer. He likes sneaking into a high school and taking pictures of pretty girls. But one day he was caught and beaten by a girl who didn't want to be photographed. So Seisa plotted an elaborate revenge scheme: he managed to learn a spell that allowed him to look like different girls. Naturally, being one of the girls, it becomes much easier for our heroes to earn their trust - and to seduce them!

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/sweet-angel]Moby Games[/url]]

Sweet Angel is a remake of the doujin game Sweet Girl 2 from the circle Burning☆Apple.
translation:
玩家扮演秃头摄影师近藤圣纪。他喜欢偷偷潜入高中，拍摄漂亮女孩。一天，一名不愿被拍照的女孩抓住圣纪，把他痛打了一顿。于是，圣纪策划出一套精密的复仇方案：他设法学会一种咒语，可以变化成不同女孩的模样。成为女孩中的一员后，赢得她们的信任——乃至诱惑她们——自然就容易多了！

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/sweet-angel]Moby Games[/url]]

《Sweet Angel》是同人社团Burning☆Apple作品《Sweet Girl 2》的重制版。
